research_question: Can visible evidence and program verification teach a small model to execute natural financial-document arithmetic more reliably than ordinary candidate supervision?

source.source_boundary: train/dev files are same-benchmark source splits; table UID is the independent cluster, not a new dataset family or full report/company identity

task_identity.input: original TAT-QA question plus visible table/paragraph evidence with R:C cell IDs
task_identity.target: structured arithmetic program over visible refs, evidence_refs, and unit; no numeric answer is requested from the model
task_identity.reference: TAT-QA derivation executed against raw visible table values
task_identity.controlled_candidates: candidate corruption is only for training-feedback comparison and is reported separately from natural question difficulty

candidate_feedback.ordinary_answer_execution_filter: uses hidden executed answer to accept candidates; may retain same-value wrong-reference programs
candidate_feedback.visible_program_filter: uses only question cues, visible refs/rows/periods, program shape and execution; no expected answer or hidden refs
candidate_feedback.oracle_clean: gold program only, diagnostic upper bound and not a deployable method

evaluation.primary_metric: program-executed paired completion across original, relevant and irrelevant variants
evaluation.transparent_baseline: question row matching plus year/operator heuristic from build_natural_tasks_v2.py
evaluation.success_threshold: visible filter must improve paired program completion by >=5 percentage points over ordinary answer-execution SFT with source-cluster interval lower bound > 0
evaluation.stop_threshold: if ordinary SFT and visible filter are equivalent or transparent baseline explains the residual, stop this mechanism and move to a different natural source/mechanism
